evidence.claim: COROB dal 1984 sviluppa macchine per dosare, miscelare e agitare vernici e inchiostri, con oltre 600 persone tra stabilimenti in Italia e India.
evidence.quote: Founded in 1984 and headquartered in San Felice sul Panaro, Italy, COROB S.p.A. has grown into a global leader in developing advanced equipment for dispensing, mixing, and shaking, primarily for tinting applications within the paint and coatings industry. || COROB employs 600+ professionals across plants in Italy and India , each specializing in distinct product lines. || COROB is a global technology leader in developing and manufacturing high-tech dispensing and mixing solutions for different applications including paints and coatings, inks and chemicals.
